title: Neighbor-Cluster Trades — Solar, Epoxy, Pools, and Fencing
content:
###  **The Trades Neighbors Notice** 

Solar panels. A finished garage floor. A new fence. A pool opened for the season. Fresh exterior paint. A stamped concrete driveway. 

These are visible, and visibility does something no advertising does — it gives neighbors permission. Someone nearby already made this decision, and the result is right there to evaluate. 

###  **Why the Second Sale Is Easier Than the First** 

The first house on a street is the expensive one to win. The second and third are meaningfully easier, because the objection that stops most homeowners — uncertainty about the outcome — has been answered by something they can see from their own driveway. 

###  **The Mistake Most Companies Make** 

Having completed a job, most companies move on to whatever the next lead happens to be, wherever it is. The three or four highest-probability prospects in the entire market are within sight of the work just finished, and nobody talks to them. 

###  **What Cluster Coverage Looks Like** 

Field outreach concentrated around completed work turns one sale into a small cluster. Conversations reference something the homeowner has already noticed, which changes the entire nature of the interaction. 

###  **Trades That Benefit Most** 

Solar, garage epoxy, fencing, pool installation and service, exterior painting, hardscaping, driveway work, and window replacement — anything a neighbor can see and evaluate without being told.
